prompt:
Subject:
Floral patterns leaning into the mirror

Main Subject:
A vertical photograph of an adult woman sitting in front of a bright dressing table with her back to the camera, looking at her face reflected in an oval mirror.

Character/Expression:
The real image is a back view, while the mirror image faces forward looking towards the camera, with a gentle expression and both fists placed under her cheeks. Shows a short brown bob, thin bangs, rounded contours, natural eyebrows, elongated eyes, a small nose, and pale lips clearly inside the mirror.

Clothing/Pose:
A cream-colored mini dress with small scattered floral patterns, thin shoulder straps, and an open back. A small ribbon in the center of the back and two tiers of lace frills at the short hem. Sitting on a white chair, leaning forward towards the vanity, with both elbows on the table.

Background/Lighting:
An oval mirror with a wooden frame and a white vanity in the center of the screen, with a houseplant and a bright window on the left. Soft white daylight enters from the left window, evenly illuminating the back and the face in the mirror. Walls and wooden parts are kept bright and clean.

Composition/Camera:
11:15 vertical composition, waist-up shot from a slightly high camera position behind. The subject's back is placed at the bottom center and the oval mirror at the top center, focusing on the face and hands in the mirror. Keep the mirror frame and dress hem within the frame.

Texture/Style:
Photorealistic live-action photograph. Naturally reproduces floral fabric, fine lace, wood frames, and mirror reflections in soft gradations of pale cream and wood colors.

Negative:
Do not make the orientation of the mirror image and real image inconsistent; do not make the hair long.
